description: Cursor-native primitives layered on top of the universal skills/entrypoint: a glob-scoped .mdc rule for Inbox conventions and the .cursorignore privacy-exclusion template generated from restricted-tagged paths.
standards_gap: Glob-scoped .cursor/rules/*.mdc activation and .cursorignore access exclusion are Cursor-only mechanisms; AGENTS.md and the Agent Skills standard cannot express per-directory rule scoping or enforce the restricted/private privacy marking.

artifacts.notes: Copy verbatim. An existing foreign file at the target is never overwritten - report and skip. Idempotent: re-copy only when the manifest-recorded hash drifts.

install.generator_semantics: Seed the target from the template if absent, then append one line per path printed by the generator command. Re-run whenever notes gain or lose the restricted/private tag; the file does not regenerate itself.

reverse.condition: only when the machine manifest records this overlay as the file's creator; a pre-existing user .cursorignore is user-owned

artifacts.notes: See the Restricted content section of ../wiring.md - the wiring doc is authoritative for the generation step.
